item.title: What's With The Memes About Trump Announcing 'The Hunger Games?' The 2026 'Patriot Games' Explained
item.description: The Patriot Games are coming to the United States in 2026 and the internet can't help but notice some similarities between the sporting event and a popular dystopian novel. Here's why.

item.title: The 'Live Slug Reaction' Meme Appeared Three Years Ago Today
item.description: Klaud is a slug alien character who appears in the 2019 film Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker. In February 2022, the character gained prominence in memes on Twitter and later on Tumblr, with an image of him staring in bewilderment being used as a reaction for depictions of LGBTQ+ romance, particularly when combined with the Live Tucker Reaction meme format.

item.title: Back When Ben Shapiro Owning The Libs Was The Dankest Thing Ever, 'Okay, This Is Epic' Was A Legendary Tweet
item.description: "Okay, This Is Epic" refers to a tweet by American conservative political commentator and writer Ben Shapiro. It has been used on sites such as 4chan and Reddit to agree with or mock a post.
